Ioannis Kentmanni medici Dresdensis doctiffimi, Observationes in duas Centurias strpium, quarum imagines (plerasq; haud tenus non publicatas à quoquam) partim in Italia, partim in aliis nationibus collectas, ad viuum expressit, nodum edidit. Eiusdem liber Germanicus de peste impressus Dresdæ per Nicolaum Vuolrab, anno 1553. in 4. & Vuitebergæ 1568. 40 Nomenclatura fexceni tarum herbarum quas Illustrif. princ. suo erudite depictas in vnum volumē congessit. Calculorum qui in corporis ac membris hominū innascuntur ge nera 12. depicta descripta; cum historijs singulorū admiradis. Tiguri apud Gesneros fratres. Nomenclatura rerum fossilium quæ in Mifnia præcipue & in aliis quoq; regionibus inueniuntur. Ibidem.

Ioannes Kent vel Cayley compositum carmine & profa. De rebus sacris lib.1. De herbarum natu ris lib.1. De animalibus lib.1. De re medica lib.1. De Goetia ac theurgia lib.1. Tabulas Astronomiæ lib.1. Claruit anno 1482. Baleus.

Ioannes Keufnerus. Vide Ioan.Kuefnerus.

Ioannes Knoxus Scotus, Anglice scripsit ad Londinenses & alios lib.1. Ad Euangelij profes fores lib.1. Qualiter fit orandum lib.1. In Psalmū ad matrem lib.1. Contra missam Papisticam lib. 1. page.notes: Scan is small and the gutter numerals (10–60) are line markers belonging to the column. Several lines in the middle of both pages are only partly legible; the transcription of these entries (especially the Kentmann, Knox and Komberak entries and the Latin titles with abbreviations) is uncertain and should be checked against the original. Page number on the right page is read as 387 and the left as 386 from the layout; neither is clearly printed in the scan at head. Running head is the letter heading "IOA" on both pages. Entries are run together in places where the scan does not show clear paragraph breaks; marked-up text may be incomplete at the ends of lines.
